Fist Marcus is a former member of the Flaming Fist, now turned into an elite agent of the Cult of the Absolute during Act Two.
“
General Ketheric wants her alive - at any cost!
„
— Marcus Falgor

Involvement

Act Two

Last Light Inn

Upon reaching Last Light Inn,  Jaheira is instantly wary of the party and summons vines to stop the player character. She believes the party members are True Souls. If Mol does not survive Act One, Marcus comes to vouch for the party, telepathically revealing that he is an Absolutist spy.

Revealing to Jaheira that Marcus is tadpoled triggers a fight against him. He has a surprise round where he summons 13  Crawling Claws and then disappears, returning to Moonrise Towers. However, he can be defeated here if party members have the passive  Alert or drank an  Elixir of Vigilance. Killing him here prevents the abduction attempt that otherwise occurs when the party first speaks with  Isobel.

If Marcus was not killed earlier, he appears when the party first speaks with Isobel. He quickly reveals his loyalty to the Absolute and  Ketheric Thorm, urging Isobel to come with him to see the warlord.

The party must make a critical choice here:

  • Fight against Marcus and his  Winged Horrors, who focus on taking down Isobel.
  • Turn against Isobel, making Marcus and the Winged Horrors allies. The rest of the inn is not initially hostile. However, siding with Marcus causes Jaheira and the Harpers to become hostile to the party. Siding with Marcus also grants the ⁠Tadpole Solidarity inspiration to party members with the  Charlatan background.

If Isobel is not saved, her barrier protecting the Last Light Inn fades, and the Shadow Curse enters the location. Everyone except Jaheira and the party either dies or become  Shadow-Cursed Undead. This causes multiple questlines to end prematurely, and causes the party to lose the traders ( Dammon,  Mattis and  Talli), who will not appear in Act Three.

Marcus' corpse can be communed with using  Speak with Dead. When asked if he left anything valuable behind, he answers with "Outside the inn... buried near graveyard... she found out...". Moving to the graveyard adjacent to Last Light Inn, a Flaming Fist's corpse is directly east of the open graves at X: -3 Y: 215, where the  Shield of Scorching Reprisal can be looted. The dead gnome's corpse implies that the Flaming Fist discovered Marcus's treachery, but was killed by him before she could warn the rest of the Fists and Harpers. A successful  DC 18 Perception Check is needed to detect the rubble,[1] and a character with at least 15 Strength[verify] is required to smash the rubble to find the body.

If Marcus is killed while attempting to kidnap Isobel, his body is later moved to the grass, north of the Last Light Inn, seemingly dumped there unceremoniously during the cleanup after the attack.

Moonrise Towers

If Isobel is not saved and Marcus survives the fight in the Last Light Inn, he moves to the top floor of Moonrise Towers, near the door to  Balthazar's room.

If Isobel is knocked out and abducted alive, Marcus remains alive. However, if Isobel does not survive the abduction, Marcus also dies, presumably killed by an angry  Ketheric Thorm.

Encounter details

Marcus is an aggressive great weapon fighter, who in the case of the encounter at the Last Light Inn focuses on trying to knock out Isobel. The fight can end very quickly if he and the  Winged Horrors act first on Initiative. He can attack up to 3 times a turn due to his  Extra Attack and the bonus attack gained through his  Great Weapon Master passive.

Three of the Winged Horrors engage Jaheira and the Harpers in combat on the first floor, while the other three land on the upper floor and race to Isobel's room to help Marcus. Their  Claws (Ghoul) can paralyse Isobel or party members, making all attacks against them critically hit.

Isobel can be defeated and carried off by either Marcus or the Winged Horrors, so she must be kept alive until all enemies are vanquished.

Jaheira may occasionally kill other Harpers or tiefling refugees by casting  Ice Storm, ruining the party's chances of getting the Leave No One Behind achievement.

Tactics

The key to defeating Marcus is preparation. During the conversation with him, the party can position themselves around the room to avoid being caught up in his  Vampiric Shout, and a cleric who is not part of the conversation can also cast  Sanctuary and / or  Warding Bond on Isobel to protect her during Marcus's first turn.[2] Marcus's high initiative means that he likely acts first but the party members can use  Alert,  Dread Ambusher,  Soulbreaker Greatsword,  Sentinel Shield, or  Elixir of Vigilance to increase their initiative rolls.

An easy approach to defeating him is to use  Banishment to put him out of the fight, saving Isobel from his wrath and allowing the group to clear out the  Winged Horrors. By the time the spell ends, he will be no match against the full party and the inn's defenders.

Alternatively, adding barrels and other objects to block the entrances confuses the enemies and limits how many of them must be fought at the same time. While some enemies attack the blockades to gain access, using explosive barrels with torches or other effects can trick enemies into damaging themselves. The party can also use  Arcane Lock to lock all doors before beginning the conversation with Isobel.

It is also wise to prepare healing spells (e.g.,  Healing Word) and healing potions (e.g.,  Potion of Greater Healing) to help Isobel if she is hurt.  Lesser Restoration is also useful in case anyone is  Paralysed by a winged horror.

Speak with Dead

Marcus' corpse can be communed with using  Speak with Dead.
Questions and responses vary depending on whether Marcus dies at Last Light Inn or Moonrise.

  • Who are you?
    • Marcus
      Marcus Falgor... raised in... Baldur's Gate...
  • Who were you before you became a True Soul?
    • Marcus
      Marcus Falgor... raised in... Baldur's Gate...
  • How did you get into the Last Light unnoticed?
    • Marcus
      Trusted...me...
  • How did you come to follow the Absolute?
    • Marcus
      Squad... captured... enlightened...
  • How did you come to work for the Absolute?
    • Marcus
      Squad... captured... enlightened...
  • What is the Absolute's end game?
    • Marcus
      Enlightenment... love... power...
  • Why were you sent here?
    • Marcus
      Capture... Selûne's... cleric...
      • Why were you after the cleric?
        • Marcus
          Orders... of the General... Absolute's... Chosen...
      • Whose orders are you following?
        • Marcus
          The... General... Absolute's... Chosen...
          • Who is the Chosen?
            • Marcus
              Ketheric... Thorm...
  • What do you know of Ketheric Thorm?
    • Marcus
      Chosen of... the Absolute. Wants... the cleric... more than anything.
  • Do you know the source of Ketheric's invulnerability?
    • Narrator
      *The corpse remains silent. It does not know.*
  • What's making Ketheric invulnerable?
    • Narrator
      *The corpse remains silent. It does not know.*
  • Did you leave anything valuable behind?
    • Marcus
      Outside the inn... buried near graveyard... she found out...
  • Do you have any valuables in this place?
    • Marcus
      Only... my... devotion...
